entries.title: DreadOut

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam Remastered Collection for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Remastered PC presentation with improved controls and performance.

primary.why: DreadOut Remastered Collection is the best current route because it enhances the original DreadOut with improved visuals, controls, and performance in a unified modern PC package.
primary.how_to_play: Buy DreadOut Remastered Collection on Steam and play the DreadOut remaster from that launcher. Use the older Steam release only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: complete original release, but superseded for modern play by the Remastered Collection.

all_releases.fidelity: DreadOut Remastered Collection on Steam with improved visuals, controls, performance, and a unified launcher.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/current-access route for the first game.

all_releases.fidelity: Console releases of DreadOut Remastered Collection.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong modern console route, but no sourced fidelity or content advantage over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox Store release of DreadOut Remastered Collection.
all_releases.reason: skip: modern console route, but no sourced fidelity or content advantage over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced content split was identified; the Remastered Collection supersedes the original release for modern play.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Remastered Collection enhances the original game and bundles it with Keepers of The Dark; it does not include DreadOut 2.
